rows.traditional: 花 A 喺 B 度
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say spending money, time, or effort on something for a purpose.

example.english: I invest a lot of time in learning English.
example.traditional: 我花咗好多時間喺學英文度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 hai2 hok6 jing1 man4 dou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when putting money or capital into assets, a business, or another opportunity for financial gain.

example.english: I want to invest some money in this new company.
example.traditional: 我想投資啲錢落呢間新公司。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tau4 zi1 di1 cin2 lok6 ni1 gaan1 san1 gung1 si1
